tools.name: SPAWN
tools.description: Start a long-running process. Returns its PID. Stdout is auto-piped to you. Use for daemons and gateways.

tools.name: EXEC
tools.description: Run a command synchronously and return its stdout. Use for one-shot commands (reading files, listing directories, etc).

tools.name: KILL
tools.description: Stop a running process by PID.

tools.name: SEND
tools.description: Send a text message to a process stdin. Use to reply to gateway.
